feeds.title: Good News Magazine
feeds.description: Since 1967, Good News has been the classical evangelical witness and ministry for renewal and reform within The United Methodist Church. The mission is to lead all people within The United Methodist Church to the faithful and vibrant practice of orthodox Wesleyan Christianity.

feeds.title: World Methodist Evangelism
feeds.description: World Methodist Evangelism brings the worldwide Wesleyan Methodist family together for the purpose of multiplying witnesses for Jesus Christ. Wesleyan Accent provides resources to pastors, laypeople and faith-seekers by clearly articulating the Wesleyan understanding of the Christian faith. Encouraging, equipping, and enlivening holistic evangelism and discipleship through word, deed, and sign.

feeds.title: United Methodist Insight
feeds.description: United Methodist Insight seeks to provide information and perspectives for concerned United Methodists and decision-makers who will shape the future of The United Methodist Church and the communities in which they live and serve. A news-and-views forum for United Methodist leaders and influencers to discern communally God's will for the global United Methodist Church.

feeds.title: First United Methodist Church Fort Worth Texas Blog
feeds.description: First United Methodist Church of Fort Worth began in 1874. We recognize four sources and criteria for theological thinking: Scripture, Tradition, Experience and Reason. Serving the Fort Worth, Texas community by providing cutting edge worship experiences, offering outstanding children's, singles, music, youth, adult ministries, community outreach and mission programs.

feeds.title: The Free Methodist Church in Canada
feeds.description: The Free Methodist Church is a movement of Christian congregations all across our country that are committed to sharing the good news of faith in Jesus Christ and encouraging believers into a life of ongoing transformation that impacts our families, our communities and our nation.

feeds.title: John Meunier
feeds.description: This blog started in 2007 as a place to explore Wesleyan theology and raise questions about United Methodism.

feeds.title: Greater NW Area of The UMC Blog
feeds.description: Covers CrossOver, Pastoral Letters, News, Resources, Vital Ministries, and Bishop's Blog. Greater Northwest (NW) Area of The United Methodist Church (UMC) offers leadership to United Methodists in the states of Alaska, Idaho, Oregon, and Washington.

feeds.title: Rev. James Howell
feeds.description: I'm pastor of Myers Park United Methodist Church in Charlotte, NC. I love to be part of conversations about life with God and in the world among Christians and clergy.

feeds.title: Central United Methodist Church Blog
feeds.description: Together in Christ: We are a wide variety of people who come together from all around the Grand Traverse area to worship God, to grow in our Christian discipleship, and to reach out in compassion and service to each other and to the world.

feeds.title: United Methodist Church of Kent Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the United Methodist Church of Kent Blog. Notes from the Pastor This series provides a conclusion to each week's sermon and devotional thoughts for the week ahead. Our mission is to help persons become aware of God's seeking love as shown especially in Jesus Christ, and to respond in faith, in love, in service, and with gifts.

feeds.title: MWiB
feeds.description: Methodist Women in Britain's aim today is to connect women with an interest in creative spirituality and a passion for global social justice.

feeds.title: Wesley Methodist Church - Church Blog
feeds.description: Wesley Methodist Church is a member of the Southend and Leigh Methodist Circuit. For over 100 years Wesley has stood at the centre of Leigh-on-Sea, Essex, and has played a vital role in the spiritual and community life of the area.

feeds.title: Starbeck Methodist Church » Minister's Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Starbeck Methodist Church. Our church offers everyone the chance to make friends and find meaning to life through Jesus Christ. We aim to offer space, time and teaching for individuals and groups to explore what the Bible has to say about the important questions of life today.

feeds.title: Pacific Northwest UMC News Blog
feeds.description: The Pacific Northwest Conference of The United Methodist Church is called to be a community, diverse and united in God's saving love, sent out in vital life-giving ministry for and with Jesus Christ. Find Coverage & Conversation about United Methodists News in the PNW!

feeds.title: Hacking Christianity Blog
feeds.description: Hacking Christianity is a United Methodist pastor Rev. Jeremy Smith's blog that uses the tenets of hacking to debug and update contemporary expressions of Christianity so that the faith operates more smoothly, holistically, and justly today.

feeds.title: David F. Watson
feeds.description: A United Methodist Blog by David Watson.

feeds.title: UM & Global
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to fostering conversations about mission and the global nature of The United Methodist Church.

feeds.title: Fennimore United Methodist Church
feeds.description: We strive to be a witness to the love of God in Christ as we minister to the needs of people in our church family, community and the world.

feeds.title: Thinking Faith
feeds.description: I am Bill Trench, the Pastor of the East Greenwich United Methodist Church. At East Greenwich Methodist Church, we really believe in the United Methodist slogan of 'Open Hearts, Open Minds, Open Doors.

feeds.title: Thank You Notes
feeds.description: This blog features stories of connectional giving made possible by the generous gifts of United Methodist Christians throughout Iowa. They highlight how our apportionments and special offerings make a positive difference in the lives of people for the sake of Christ.

feeds.title: Methodist Children's Home - Inside Out Blog
feeds.description: Methodist Children's Home provides services to children and youth through our residential community program at the Waco campus and Boys Ranch near Axtell as well as foster care and family outreach services. Methodist Children's Home offers hope to children, youth and families through a nurturing, Christian community.

feeds.title: Brighton First Updates
feeds.description: Sherry is the senior pastor at First United Methodist Church of Brighton, Michigan. She is currently leading the church through a revitalization process that involves aligning the church's purpose and vision with its worship experiences, faith formation programs, community outreach and mission.

feeds.title: The President and Vice President of the Methodist Conference
feeds.description: The President of the Methodist Conference, the Revd Loraine N Mellor and the Vice-President, Jill Baker, blog about their year of office which began on 24 June 2017. Read about the places they visit, the people they meet and the issues that concern them.

feeds.title: Texas Methodist History
feeds.description: The mission of Texas Methodist History is to preserve the official records of the Texas Annual Conference and to assist local churches preserve their own historical records.

feeds.title: Raleigh Court United Methodist Church » Pastor's Blog
feeds.description: Raleigh Court United Methodist Church's mission is to spread love, joy, peace, kindness, and openness to everyone through the love and faithfulness of Jesus Christ!

feeds.title: Extreme Center Blog
feeds.description: Scott Jameson Jones currently serves as the resident bishop of the Texas Conference of the United Methodist Church with offices in Houston.

feeds.title: First United Methodist Church of Olympia Blog
feeds.description: First UMC Olympia welcomes people of all ages, all abilities, all sexual orientations and gender identities, all nationalities and ethnicities, the poor and the rich, single people and the many forms of family to join in our mission of making disciples of Jesus Christ!

feeds.title: Wesley United Methodist Church Blog
feeds.description: A Christian Community making the difference by sharing the love of Jesus Christ. We believe in 'Grace in Action,' in personal experiences of God's love that translate into service in God's world.
